description: Bicrystal tensile-creep hazard model with no stress-concentration factor. Surface triple-line density is treated as the density of surface nucleation sites.

geometry.circular_neck_default: For a circular neck, perimeter/area = 4/width, so siteDensityFactor = 4.

stress_coupling.note: For this bicrystal fit the stress-concentration factor is intentionally fixed to 1.

rate_law.entropy_form: Equivalent form: r_nuc = nu0*exp(Sstar/kB)*exp(-Hstar/(kB*T)), with Hstar=Gstar+T*Sstar.

barrier_model.entropy_definition: Sstar = -(dGstar/dT)_sigma, evaluated by finite differences/interpolation across temperature slices

entropy_stress_polynomial.description: Polynomial representation of Sstar/kB as a function of log10(sigma_local/sigma_ref) at each fitted temperature.

diffusion_model.note: Defaults from uploaded bicrystal Coble creep paper: ScSZ-ScSZ cation grain-boundary and surface diffusivity.
